title: The residual book - one year of seasoning required
note: Tests H2: that the wide book's backtest was inflated by names that listed in 2024 or later, contributing a few years each to the research era while making up half the book in the sealed year. Requiring 365 days of tape before a name is tradable CUTS the research total from +374.8% to +143.6% and Sharpe from 0.907 to 0.573, while raising positive years from six of nine to seven and flattening the profile: 2022 +15%, 2023 +12%, 2024 +14%, 2025 +16%. A lower backtest with an even year profile is the shape of an edge; a higher one carried by a composition that did not exist at the time is the shape of an artefact. 365 is one year, chosen as a round period rather than as the best of the five values tried; all five are recorded in the experiments directory.
sealed_note: 2026 was read deliberately and once. No parameter was swept to produce this configuration, so nothing in the forward number is contaminated by selection - which will stop being true the moment tuning starts.
